statement: The static census walked all 88 files of organism/scale-52000 (5126010 physical lines, 5125448 by the manifest count) line by line without loading the organism, in 18.0 s at a peak working set of 446.2 MB; its streamed content hash equals the manifest hash and 0 edges are illegal. By the static rule (a cell is live when a path of edges reaches it from one of the 141319 periodic cells or 7 hosted problem cells, an edge when its source is live, a region or circuit when it holds a live cell; 6 closure passes) 411858 of 416000 cells (99.00 percent) and 4632748 of 4656829 edges (99.48 percent) are live; 4142 cells are dead (4125 with no edge in, 17 fed only by dead cells). Load bearing = 5096613 live declarations + 1174 structure lines = 5097787 of 5126010 lines (99.45 percent; 5097225 of 5125448 by the manifest count), with 28223 dead declarations. The static rule is an upper bound: reachable is not ran, and at a 16 tick horizon only 406881 cells could run at all.

development.what: the seed it describes: every emitted line is walked and nothing is loaded

heldOut.what: none: a census is a measurement of one seed, and the liveness it writes (the prune input) comes from the same drive and tasks it reports

split.contaminated: no held-out set: the static census describes the same lines it walks

rule: a cell is live when a path of edges reaches it from a periodic cell (due at tick 0 whatever its input) or from a cell the hosted algebra and sequence problems inject into; an edge is live when its source is live (then both ends are); a region or circuit is live when it holds a live cell. Nothing is run: this is an upper bound on what runs.

closure.edgeFile: OS temp dir, removed when the census ends

live.phases: the static rule: reachable from a periodic cell or a hosted problem cell through the edge lists; nothing was run

cells.encoding: bitset, bit i of byte i>>3 at position i&7, base64

edges.encoding: bitset, bit i of byte i>>3 at position i&7, base64
